scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a home purchase loan, and I'm checking on the status. Could you tell me if my application has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate on your loan is 6.5%.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for letting me know. What are the total costs associated with this loan? Also, is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $4,502.51. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Can you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae. You were approved for a Conventional: First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Got it. One last question: what is my debt-to-income ratio, and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 45%. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot provide details on how it affected your application.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all the information. I feel well-informed about my loan status and details.

<Very Satisfied> - The agent provided clear, honest, and comprehensive answers to all my questions, demonstrating competence, courtesy, and reliability. I feel confident about my loan and the service I received.
